The problem

Your greenhouse isn't running on one system

Verbal instructions, paper checks, gut feel: there's no system holding everyone to the same standard, and no real-time view of how your greenhouse is actually doing.

The result
  • Direction comes too late
  • Quality drops
  • Speed drops
"You're giving random instructions everywhere at once."
Sound familiar?

What this means every day

Owner

  • ›No control on what's happening
  • ›Loss of speed, quality and margin

Foreman

  • ›Putting out fires instead of leading
  • ›No backbone. All the responsibility.

Workers

  • ›Unclear expectations
  • ›Inconsistent judgment, arbitrary calls
The solution

How GrowPilot works

GrowPilot makes quality and speed visible every day, and corrects in real time.

  • Deviations detected immediately
  • Everyone works to the same standard
  • Foremen always one step ahead
  • Multilingual: everyone works in their own language
01
Push notifications on deviations Straight to the foreman's phone: no searching, no waiting
02
One action per signal No cluttered dashboard: one concrete task, ready to act on
03
Set your own standard per crop Quality and speed: adjustable per crop, visible on the work floor right away
How it works

In three steps

01

Set standards per crop

You define the quality and speed standard. Per crop, your way.

02

See performance

Real-time view of quality and speed. Per location, per day.

03

Correct in real time

Foremen receive concrete to do's. Nothing gets missed.

What you see

Clear dashboards

From a daily overview for the owner to concrete action items for the foreman: all in one place.

Our story

Built from inside the greenhouse

When your business grows, you can't be everywhere at once. Lowie Verbeek noticed the standards were on paper, but daily execution depended on who happened to be walking around and how busy things were.

Random checks. Ad hoc adjustments. Quality and speed that declined as soon as attention declined.

GrowPilot was built to change that. Not reacting after the fact, but leading proactively — even when you're not there yourself.

— Lowie Verbeek, Director BioVerbeek B.V.

Integrations

Works with your system

GrowPilot integrates directly with the three most-used path-registration systems in Dutch greenhouse horticulture.

No manual entry. No extra systems. Your data, instantly visible.

Using a different path-registration system? Get in touch. We'd be happy to explore the possibilities.
